title: Unlocking Expressivity with OP_CAT
chapters: OpCat and the Power of Covenants
The Magic of Covenants in Bitcoin Script
Flexibility in Fee Rates and Vaults
The Benefits of CAT in Bitcoin
The Design Space of Opcodes in Bitcoin
The Excitement of Cat in Bitcoin
The Challenges of Expressivity in Programming Languages
description:
Explore the exciting world of Bitcoin development with our panel discussion on OpCat, a proposed upgrade that could significantly enhance Bitcoin's functionality. Our experts break down the technical aspects of OpCat, explaining how this simple concatenation operation could enable powerful features like covenants, vaults, and more efficient transaction processing.

Speakers: Andrew Poelstra - Blockstream, Brandon Black - Swan, Rijndael   - Taproot Wizards and niftynei (Lisa) - Base58⛓️🔓
